onboardingPage.title: Create your workspace
onboardingPage.description: A workspace holds your team: its members, their roles and invitations. Invited to an existing one? Open the link in your invitation email instead.

workspaceSwitcher.newWorkspaceDescription: You’ll be its owner, with every permission. You can invite people next.

suspendedPage.title: “{name}” is suspended
suspendedPage.description: A platform admin suspended this workspace, so nobody can open it for now. Contact support to get access back, or switch to another workspace.
